title: Brochure cover pair
slide_intent: Compare photographic and abstract covers because a brand system must support different kinds of messages.
strategic_value: Shared typography, circular geometry and signature placement can connect visually different publications.
demonstration: Two pale brochure covers pair a photograph with orange overlays at left and abstract colored circles on dark at right.
practical_value: Compare common structure with variable image treatment.

content_islands.name: Cover images
content_islands.spec: Keep the photographic panel on the left cover and circular abstract panel on the right.

content_islands.name: Editorial frame
content_islands.spec: Place each headline beneath its image and retain the small bottom signature.

reference_purposes.Application: The source identifies the two publication covers as brochures.
